name: hev ask
summary: Agent-readable docs digest plus a ⌘K search overlay, shipped as the npm package @hevmind/ask for Astro docs sites.
description: hev ask distills a documentation site into a committed "ask digest" — a markdown tree a coding agent can tree, cat and grep — and answers readers from the same material through a ⌘K search overlay. It ships as the npm package @hevmind/ask (Astro integration, /api/ask endpoint, SearchOverlay component and ask CLI binaries) built on a Go core that builds the digest offline from markdown. The hevask.com site is retired and now redirects to the GitHub repo.
contains: committed ask digest: markdown tree readable with tree, cat and grep
⌘K search overlay answering from the same digest
Astro integration with /api/ask endpoint and SearchOverlay component
Go core CLI (ask) plus an offline digest builder, no Astro dependency
published on npm as @hevmind/ask with prebuilt per-platform binaries
Docusaurus, VitePress and MkDocs adapters designed but not shipped (RFC 0004)
agentic answers need ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY; otherwise keyword search
